note: Platforms Romwright does not fully support, each with the fact that blocks it. Tier 1 means a committed gate report measures it; the support matrix generator refuses to print a tier-1 claim whose gate report is missing, so a platform is listed here only once someone has looked. Evidence paths are relative to the pinned Ghidra install (docs/upstream-ghidra.md) unless stated otherwise; they were checked against Ghidra 12.1.3. Loaders for 3DS (NCCH/NCSD/CIA), PS3 (SELF/SPRX), Vita (SELF), PSP (PRX), Switch (NCA/XCI) and Xbox 360 (XEX) ship in crates/romwright-core/src/native/ and route through parse_container. Every console processor is now modelled: the pinned install ships SPU (GhidraSPU), R5900 with MMI/VU0 (ghidra-emotionengine-reloaded), Allegrex with VFPU (Processors/Allegrex), and Xenon VMX128 is native (native/languages/xenon). The only remaining blocker is per-title/console-provisioned key material, which II.1 forbids fetching at runtime.

platforms.blocker: The PRX loader imports decrypted ELF32 Allegrex modules (e_type 0xFFA0, sceModuleInfo, .lib.ent/.lib.stub), and the pinned install's Allegrex processor ships the full VFPU: allegrexVfpu.sinc, allegrexVfpuBase.sinc and allegrexVfpuGenerated.sinc model the vector unit (vadd.s/p/t/q and the matrix ops decode under Allegrex:LE:32:default). No processor gap remains; the only open item is per-title key material, covered by the encrypted-container row.
platforms.evidence: crates/romwright-core/src/native/psp.rs imports PRX; Ghidra/Processors/Allegrex/data/languages/allegrexVfpu*.sinc (74+340+553 VFPU constructors); allegrex.sla decodes vadd.s. Verified: word 0x60030201 -> 'vadd.s S000,S030,S003'.

platforms.blocker: The pinned install ships ghidra-emotionengine-reloaded, a complete R5900 language (r5900:LE:32:default) whose eecore.sinc models the MMI 128-bit multimedia ops (paddw/psubw/pnor under prime=28) and vuupper.sinc the VU0 macro-mode. The scalar gate row already passes; the MMI/VU0 ops decode under the same language. No processor gap remains.
platforms.evidence: Ghidra/Extensions/ghidra-emotionengine-reloaded/data/languages/{eecore,vuupper}.sinc; r5900.sla decodes paddw (word 0x70430808 -> 'paddw at,v0,v1'). native/specs/r5900-LE-32-default bundle present.

platforms.blocker: The pinned install ships the GhidraSPU extension (SPU:BE:128:default) with a full spu.sinc — the carved SPU ELF32 images decode (a/lqd/nop verified). The SELF/SPRX loader unwraps PPU images and carves embedded SPU images. No processor gap remains.
platforms.evidence: Ghidra/Extensions/GhidraSPU/data/languages/spu.{sinc,sla}; spu.sla decodes 'a lr,lr,lr' and 'nop lr'. native/specs/SPU-BE-128-default bundle present; crates/romwright-core/src/native/ps3.rs carves SPU images.

platforms.blocker: The Xenon language (PowerPC:BE:64:Xenon-32addr) now models VMX128's 128 vector registers and the XEX loader maps the image. The remaining gap is XEX decryption: retail images are encrypted and compressed, and the keys are not bundled (the encrypted-container row covers this).
platforms.evidence: native/languages/xenon builds PowerPC:BE:64:Xenon-32addr with VMX128; crates/romwright-core/src/native/xex.rs maps the container. Retail XEX decryption keys are not in this repository.

platforms.input: Encrypted console containers (3DS CIA, PS3/Vita SELF, Switch NCA/XCI, Xbox 360 XEX)
platforms.blocker: Retail images are encrypted. The loaders decrypt with bundled public keys where those exist (Xbox 360 XEX retail key, PS3 APP vault, Vita public MetaKeys, 3DS zeros fixed key), and now accept user-supplied keys through a KeyStore (`--keys <file>`): a Switch prod.keys supplies header_key/key_area_key, a PS3 .rap derives the NPDRM title key, a Vita .klic unwraps NPDRM, and a 3DS aes_keys.txt supplies slot0xNN/fixed_system. What remains unreachable is content whose key only the console holds and the user has not dumped — PSP KIRK device-key crypto is the hard case (no file-supplied key can drive it; pre-decrypt with prxtool/PPSSPP). II.1 still forbids any runtime fetch; the keys come only from a file the user provides.
platforms.evidence: crates/romwright-core/src/native/keys.rs (KeyStore: prod.keys/aes_keys.txt named-hex + raw .rap/.klic); import_with(data, keys) on switch/threeds/vita/ps3/psp; tests prove a retail-keyed NCA, an NPDRM SELF via .rap, and a klic-wrapped Vita SELF import only when the key is supplied.
